items.title: Mose Allison Sr. Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: St. Blooming started me to blow in the jug.

ctx.x: And what instruments did you start on?

Well, St. Blooming started me to blow in the jug. I was learning to blow a jug, but I always could sing a little blues myself. And I know a little bit how to hit on the piano a little bit. It wasn't very much. Just some kind of song I'd try to play on the piano myself, watch anybody else play. And then I'd get down there and try to play myself. Not by no notes or nothing like that, just by air.
Let me ask St. Blooming a question. St. Blooming a little bit. What instruments do you play? We forgot that.
